ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_contrastive_softmax_advantage_diff_v3_repaired
ir.intuition: Contrastive softmax pairwise loss using advantage differences as temperature scaling, with clamping and eps safeguards to ensure numerical stability and finite gradients.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_diff = advantage_w - advantage_l
abs_adv_diff = clamp(abs(adv_diff), min=eps)
scaled_diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / (abs_adv_diff + eps)
exp_scaled_diff = exp(scaled_diff)
sum_exp = clamp(exp_scaled_diff + 1, min=eps)
lse = log(sum_exp)
weights_scaled = weight * abs_adv_diff
loss_vec = -weights_scaled * (scaled_diff - lse)
loss = sum(loss_vec) / clamp(sum(weights_scaled), min=eps)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape))
    adv_diff = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)
    abs_adv_diff = ops.clamp(ops.abs(adv_diff), min=eps, max=1e8)
    denom_diff = ops.add(abs_adv_diff, eps)
    scaled_diff = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), denom_diff)
    exp_scaled_diff = ops.exp(ops.clamp(scaled_diff, max=50))
    sum_exp = ops.clamp(ops.add(exp_scaled_diff, lpw.new_ones(lpw.shape)), min=eps)
    lse = ops.log(sum_exp)
    weights_scaled = ops.mul(weight, abs_adv_diff)
    loss_vec = ops.neg(ops.mul(weights_scaled, ops.sub(scaled_diff, lse)))
    denom = ops.clamp(ops.sum(weights_scaled), min=eps)
    return ops.div(ops.sum(loss_vec), denom).mean()
